title: acde.config.jsonc
description: An acde project's configuration: a window app (type app) or a desktop (type desktop); acdev build turns it into the package's package.json manifest

name.description: The package name; defaults to package.json's name

apiLevel.description: The contract level (API_LEVEL); when left out, acdev build writes the current level

public.description: The directory of static files copied as they are; defaults to public

entry.description: An HTML page (default index.html) or a module whose default export is a WindowApp; "/" means the backend renders the page (needs a backend); not used when a framework is recognized

framework.description: How to build: auto (default) recognizes the framework from the dependencies (Next.js, Nuxt, SvelteKit, Astro, React Router, Remix, Angular, Vite, Create React App, or package.json's build script) and uses its own build; none uses acdev's bundler (Bun.build, the entry is HTML or a module)

session.description: acde:session (sign out, language …; a shell module, for system apps only)

desktops.description: acde:desktops (list / switch desktops; a shell module, for system apps only)

windows.description: acde:windows (every window: list, focus, hide, animate; a shell module, for system apps only)

packages.description: acde:packages (refresh and install packages, list and run native programs; a shell module, for system apps only)

inspect.description: acde:inspect (see and operate the desktop; a shell module, for system apps only)

desktop.description: acde:desktop (desktop events and pinned panels; a shell module, for system apps only)

setDefault.description: acde:setDefault (set default apps; a shell module, for system apps only)

camera.description: The camera of navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia (the system must agree too: macOS privacy settings)

microphone.description: The microphone of navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia (the system must agree too: macOS privacy settings)

capabilities.description: acde capabilities; other keys are names of desktop services

optional.description: The entries of capabilities the app can do without (each also listed in capabilities); the rest are required, and without them the app is not listed and does not start

services.description: The desktop services used (imported as acde:<name>); system module names are not allowed

size.description: The window page's initial size [width, height] in logical pixels, without the frame; default 800x600. In single-app mode (acdev runtime app) it is the initial size of the host window's content area (within the work area)

material.description: The window background material drawn under the page: glass (liquid glass; role regular or clear), blur (background blur with a tint, no lens or highlight) or none. Names are open ([a-z0-9._-], at most 64 bytes) for effects added later; an unknown name draws as none with one warning. The page background must be transparent for it to show. Same as acde:window setMaterial at start

group.description: glass only: a session-wide group name; windows (of any app) with the same group merge their window glass; page elements never merge across windows

spacing.description: merge distance in logical pixels, default 10

overrides.description: parameter name (as --acde-glass-* without the prefix: blur, tint, outline, ...) to its CSS text

region.description: the whole window (default) or the title bar only

backend.description: false: no backend; by default server.ts and the like are looked for

icon.description: Icon: a Dopame icon name (one of IconName in @acde/api: files, browser, editor, office, term, projects, dash, team, dopa, settings, store, app, timer, cards, list, chart, calc, music, video, photo, paint, game, chat, mail, calendar, code, book, map, weather), or an image in the project (.svg / .png, relative to the project directory, copied into the package by acdev build); acdev check warns about other values
